title: Flower Fidget Spinner (print-in-place)
description: A six-petal flower that spins freely on a central post. The hub is captured under the post head; it prints already assembled.
use: Desk fidget. Print-in-place - flick it once to break the layer bond.
material: PLA or PETG, 0.12-0.16 mm layers, no supports (0.5 mm air gaps), cool well. Clearances: hub bore 0.5 mm radial, 0.6 mm vertical.
fit_notes: Hub bore radius 3.9 vs post 3.4 (0.5 mm radial); rotor floats 0.5 mm above base disc and 0.6 mm below post head.
